headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6 combining advanced intelligence with operational efficiency
body: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, positioning the model as a breakthrough in frontier intelligence paired with improved computational efficiency. For healthcare AI deployments, this matters because efficiency gains directly impact inference costs in clinical settings where real-time decision support and documentation assistance run continuously. Healthcare organizations evaluating large language models for EHR integration, clinical note generation, and diagnostic assistance will need to reassess vendor landscape economics. The combination of capability and efficiency could shift unit economics for value-based care programs relying on AI-assisted clinical workflows. Consulting implications include revisiting current LLM contracts and pilot programs to determine if newer generation models justify migration costs versus incumbent solutions.
